discovery.title: Enable mDNS Discovery
discovery.description: Auto-discover ESPHome devices on the local network via mDNS (_esphomelib._tcp).

reconnectInterval.title: Reconnect Interval (seconds)
reconnectInterval.description: Base interval before reconnection attempt. Doubles on each failure, capped at 5 minutes.

host.title: Host
host.description: Hostname or IP address of the ESPHome device.

encryptionKey.title: Encryption Key (PSK)
encryptionKey.description: Base64-encoded 32-byte pre-shared key from ESPHome api.encryption.key. Leave blank for plaintext.

password.title: Legacy Password
password.description: Legacy ESPHome API password. Currently unsupported by esphome-client 1.3.0; prefer Noise encryption via encryptionKey.

name.title: Override Name
name.description: Optional display name override for this device.

statelessSwitches.title: Stateless Switches
statelessSwitches.description: Switch entity objectIds to expose as HomeKit StatelessProgrammableSwitch buttons instead of persistent Switch accessories.

include.title: Include Only
include.description: Whitelist of entity objectIds to expose. If empty, all entities included.

exclude.title: Exclude
exclude.description: Blacklist of entity objectIds to hide.
